metadata.title: Metric entropy of Kähler potentials
metadata.abstract: We prove sharp metric entropy estimates for spaces of Kähler potentials. In complex dimension $n$, normalized potentials have Kolmogorov entropy of order $\e^{-n}$ in the background $L^1$ metric. On a polarized manifold, a relative-entropy sublevel has the same order in the Mabuchi--Darvas $d_1$ metric, including its full finite-energy closure. The upper bound is $C_X(1+B)^{n+1}\e^{-n}$ for entropy budget $B$. For toric potentials, the sharp exponent is $n/2$.
